izmyshUnavailable: IZMYSH cannot launch yet. Its separate native qualification adapter is not implemented.
matchingBootstrapRequired: Prepare and save the matching bootstrap for {profile} ({edition}) as {saveName}, then confirm the console save before launching.
automaticLAN: Automatic recommendation; leave empty to rediscover
usbOnly: Required for built-in USB input, not guided manual input.
consoleFirmware: Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1 is the reference target. Newer firmware is not assumed compatible.
smilebasicPrerequisites: Use SmileBASIC full 4.4.9, or demo 4.4.6 only with a demo-capable host. Keep the game on internal storage with more than 20 MiB free in its save.
networkPrerequisites: Connect the console by Ethernet to a LAN reachable from this host. Use a US English USB keyboard layout.
cablePrerequisites: Use a USB-C data cable, not a charge-only cable. The Mac must receive power from the console for the required USB data direction.
driverSecurityGuidance: USB input requires Apple Silicon macOS 14 or later and an approved unsigned driver. Review Recovery and startup security requirements yourself. This readiness check never installs a driver or changes SIP or startup security.
applyBeforeLaunch: Apply the host and input preferences before preparing or launching a session.
chooseKnownHost: Choose a host from Developer Options. The saved host is not in the pinned manifest.
unsupportedEdition: This host does not support that edition. Select full SmileBASIC 4.4.9 or choose a demo-capable host.
chooseTransport: Select manual, keyboard, composite or external-pico input.
chooseLANIPv4: Enter a usable LAN IPv4 address, or clear the override to use network discovery.
hostUnsupported: Not supported by this host. Choose a compatible host in Developer Options.
requiresVerifiedSession: Requires a verified retained-RPC session and the tool adapter.
supportedEdition: Supported edition. Use the matching bootstrap setup.
transportUnverified: Input preference only. Readiness must verify the actual transport before use.

@noSession.description: Idle shell status, not a readiness claim.

simulatedEnvironment: Simulated environment. No real hardware checks.
restartConsole: Restart the console before another attempt.
safeFailure: The operation failed before console input. Check diagnostics, then run readiness checks.
commandRejected: This action is not available in the current session state.
savePrompt: Complete the console save or overwrite prompt, then confirm here.
buildLimitations: Development shell. Console workflows are not available yet.

@buildLimitations.description: Honest scope of the initial scaffold.

driverDisclosure: This driver is unsigned. It requires reduced startup security and user-approved kernel extensions. Re-enabling full protection with this driver has not been verified.
driverSigning: The pinned upstream setup also calls for disabling SIP, which reduces macOS protection. A working custom configuration may differ. Signing or notarizing this app does not approve the kernel extension. The app never changes SIP or startup security.
driverRecovery: If you choose USB input, shut down your Apple Silicon Mac, hold the power button for startup options, choose Options, then open Startup Security Utility in Recovery. Review Reduced Security and the option to allow user management of kernel extensions from identified developers. These steps are yours to perform, not commands run by this app. Do not change a working custom security configuration blindly.
driverApproval: After installation, review the kernel-extension approval request in System Settings, Privacy & Security. Follow macOS approval and restart prompts. An unsigned extension may still be rejected by the current policy; a SIP status summary cannot prove compatibility.
driverRestart: Every installation or reinstall requires a Mac restart. After approval and restart, check readiness again. A loaded driver does not prove USB keyboard enumeration or accepted console input.
driverConfirmText: I understand the security consequences. Continue to the macOS administrator prompt to run the verified upstream installer. This does not change startup security for me.
driverInstalling: Waiting for administrator approval and driver installation. Do not start a console session.
driverInstallError: Installation did not complete. It may have changed the installed driver. Check approval and restart state before retrying.
driverDeveloper: Developer-supplied pinned driver source. Not bundled or cleared for redistribution.
driverNoSecurityChange: Guided manual launch does not require this driver or reduced security.
driverVerifyError: Driver package verification or availability failed. Nothing was installed. Restore the pinned driver files before retrying.
automatedInputUnavailable: Automated console input is not available.
selectGuidedManual: Select manual input to use Guided manual launch without a USB driver.
manualInputAvailable: Guided manual input is available. You enter and acknowledge each console step.
manualSlot: Open an empty Slot 0 editor on the console. Confirm the slot is empty before continuing.
manualBootstrap: Enter this complete matching bootstrap.bas in Slot 0. Continue only after checking every line.
manualDirect: Return to Direct mode with an empty prompt, keeping the complete bootstrap in Slot 0.
manualSave: Enter this command and press Enter once. Handle any save or overwrite prompt on the console deliberately. Confirm the completed save in the next step.
manualLoad: Enter this command in Direct mode and press Enter once.
manualLoadConfirm: Accept the console's YES (full) or OK (demo) load prompt with Enter. Wait at least one second after it finishes before continuing.
manualRun: Enter RUN and press Enter. Continue when the console returns to its prompt.
manualRemove: Enter REMOVE once and press Enter. The expected result is Out of memory. Never repeat REMOVE in the same game session. Stop if the result differs.
manualStart: After the expected Out of memory, enter this session-bound START command and press Enter. Acknowledging input is not verification.
resourcesReleased: Cleanup confirmed: input released, tools stopped and owned host processes closed.
verificationEvidence: 4/4 verified: exploit and filesystem verified, filesystem restored, cleanup confirmed.
heldVerificationEvidence: Verified retained session: filesystem verified and restored, donor cleaned up, deferred cleanup and live RPC confirmed.
